title: Endorsement Size and the Endorsement Deposit — Installment Payment Plans
content:
**Clause.** For the endorsement deposit taken on an Owner Auto Policy term billed on the Cardinal Point Monthly EFT Plan or the Cardinal Point Monthly Card Autopay Plan of the **Installment Payment Plans**, a percentage of the endorsement balance is added to the deposit according to the total additional premium booked on the Owner Auto Policy term:

- at least 200.00: 5 percent of the endorsement balance;
- at least 100.00 but less than 200.00: 2.5 percent;
- less than 100.00: nothing.

The total is every additional premium transaction booked on the owner term, read from the Owner Auto Policy term's premium transactions.

**Judging the band (hypothetical totals)**

| Additional premium booked | Percentage added |
|---|---|
| 199.99 | 2.5 |
| 200.00 | 5 |
| 100.00 | 2.5 |
| 99.99 | none |
